architectural_determination.gap_summary: The productive GCDR path treats missing evidence for any listed criterion as review-blocking incompleteness, even when explicit evidence already establishes a decisive dominance or mandatory-criterion winner.

causal_replay_without_roby_rerun.method: read-only deterministic replay of frozen productive GCDR intake components

localized_mechanism.assessment_adapter_behavior: Every option×criterion pair without explicit certified evidence is adapted to ComplexDecisionCriterionOutcome.INSUFFICIENT.
localized_mechanism.realizer_behavior: A report with no recommendation and non-REVIEW_REQUIRED status is rendered as the fixed 'evidencia certificada es insuficiente' abstention.
localized_mechanism.reasoner_behavior: Any option containing an INSUFFICIENT criterion becomes REVIEW_REQUIRED; if any option is REVIEW_REQUIRED the recommendation is withheld and the report status becomes INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
